diagnosis: The CRDT snapshot endpoint fetches historical binary document state snapshots matching document_id and version_id. It authenticates current_user but omits any check on whether document_id belongs to current_user.tenant_id, exposing confidential document revisions and author metadata.
exploit_request:
GET /crdt/snapshots/doc_merger_agreement_v2/versions/ver_9941a HTTP/1.1
Host: docs.enterprise-collab.net
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
